integrity: The primary source was inspected at the definitions, convexity criterion, Theorem 1, and radial-symmetry deformation. The proof here is analytic: it first forces the center into the unit disk, converts equal sector masses to equally spaced circle points, and converts each convexity condition to one regular-polygon half-plane inequality. The bundled numerical checker is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for normalized arclength measure on the unit circle. It does not classify arbitrary radial densities or non-spiral equicoverings, and no stability statement under perturbation of the measure is claimed.
title: Regular-polygon moduli of circular spiral equicoverings
